rulings: Bodies GeM lists under a ministry (banks, PSUs, regulators, funds) count as that ministry's tenders.
Hardware-only AI purchases (GPU servers, AI-capable PCs, edge kits, cameras sold as 'AI') are not AI tenders; AI software, models, platforms or services are.
In scope means bought now: a topic named only as a possible future extension is not in scope.
GeM's auto-generated 'Similar Category' list on the bid document's first page is not evidence.
Related-but-not-enough items in the topic definition are not the topic on their own.
